```java
/** Luhn check digit (0-9) over the digits contained in {@code s}. */
protected static int luhn(String s) {
    int sum = 0;
    boolean dbl = true;
    for (int i = s.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        char c = s.charAt(i);
        if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
            continue;
        }
        int d = c - '0';
        if (dbl) {
            d *= 2;
            if (d > 9) {
                d -= 9;
            }
        }
        sum += d;
        dbl = !dbl;

    return (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10;
```

```java
package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.util.Locale;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.repository.OwnerRepository;

/**
 * Assigns the owner's {@code customerCode} formatted {@code <CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>}: CITY3 and
 * LAST3 are the upper-cased first three letters of the city and last name, and NNNN is a per-city
 * 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the owners already in that city. Runs before
 * {@link SaveOwner}, so this owner is not yet counted (e.g. 'LON-SMI-0007').
 */
public class AssignOwnerCustomerCode {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
        String city3 = prefix(owner.getCity());
        String last3 = prefix(owner.getLastName());
        int sequence = cityCount(owner.getCity(), ownerRepository) + 1;
        owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence));
    }

    private static String prefix(String value) {
        return value.substring(0, Math.min(3, value.length())).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private static int cityCount(String city, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
        return (int) ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
            .filter(existing -> city.equals(existing.getCity()))
            .count();
    }
}
```

```java
/** Luhn check digit (0-9) over the digits contained in {@code s}. */
protected static int luhn(String s) {
    int sum = 0;
    boolean dbl = true;
    for (int i = s.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        char c = s.charAt(i);
        if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
            continue;
        }
        int d = c - '0';
        if (dbl) {
            d *= 2;
            if (d > 9) {
                d -= 9;
            }
        }
        sum += d;
        dbl = !dbl;
    }
    return (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10;
}
```

```java
package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.util.Locale;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.repository.OwnerRepository;

/**
 * Assigns the owner's {@code customerCode} formatted {@code <CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>}: CITY3 and
 * LAST3 are the upper-cased first three letters of the city and last name, and NNNN is a per-city
 * 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the owners already in that city. Runs before
 * {@link SaveOwner}, so this owner is not yet counted (e.g. 'LON-SMI-0007').
 */
public class AssignOwnerCustomerCode {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
        String city3 = prefix(owner.getCity());
        String last3 = prefix(owner.getLastName());
        int sequence = cityCount(owner.getCity(), ownerRepository) + 1;
        owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence));
    }

    private static String prefix(String value) {
        return value.substring(0, Math.min(3, value.length())).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private static int cityCount(String city, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
        return (int) ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
            .filter(existing -> city.equals(existing.getCity()))
            .count();
    }
}
```

Note a **format discrepancy** worth flagging: this class produces `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (e.g. `LON-SMI-0007`), but the OpenAPI doc and examples describe/expect `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (e.g. `SMI-0007`).

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner, stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-02'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household).
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, e.g. 'J.S.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned membership code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', e.g. 'SMI-0007'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year, e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by all owners at the same last name and address (a household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key, 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email empty when absent); two owners are duplicates only when their whole keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive), counted just before this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3 - starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The region derived from the owner's city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created today (by registration date), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred way to contact this owner - 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
